name: Deezer S.A.
summary: Deezer S.A., headquartered in Paris, France, is a global provider of digital audio streaming services. Its platform delivers a diverse array of content to users worldwide, encompassing music tracks, audiobooks, podcasts, and live radio broadcasts. Listeners can access these services through the company's dedicated website, Deezer.com, as well as various integrated wireless audio systems, with a presence in approximately 180 countries.
